typography.import_instruction: Import fonts via Google Fonts in index.html: <link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700;800&display=swap' rel='stylesheet'>

usage_rules.headings: Use Nunito for all H1-H6. Font weight 700 or 800 for H1/H2 to create a friendly, bubbly feel suitable for paediatrics. Letter spacing tight (-0.02em).
usage_rules.body: Use Manrope for all paragraphs and UI text. Excellent legibility for medical data.
usage_rules.buttons: Nunito, weight 700, uppercase tracking-wide for primary actions.

primary.name: Ocean Teal
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, key icons

secondary.name: Calming Sky
secondary.usage: Backgrounds for cards, secondary buttons, highlight areas

accent.name: Warm Sand
accent.usage: Call to actions (secondary), notifications, warmth accents

textures.noise: Use a subtle SVG noise overlay on the main background to reduce clinical sterility.

public_pages.spacing: Generous. Section padding py-24 or py-32.
public_pages.rules: Avoid symmetry. Use offset images. Place 'blob' shapes in background behind grids.

dashboards.style: Soft Utility. Cards should have no borders, just soft shadows and ample padding (p-6).
dashboards.sidebar: Floating sidebar style (detached from edge) with rounded corners.

buttons.primary: h-12 px-8 rounded-full bg-[#2A9D8F] hover:bg-[#21867a] text-white font-bold shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: h-12 px-8 rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-[#2A9D8F] text-[#2A9D8F] hover:bg-[#E0F2F1] font-bold

cards.feature: bg-white rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-floating hover:shadow-soft transition-all border border-slate-50
cards.dashboard: bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-100

inputs.style: h-12 rounded-xl border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2A9D8F]/20 transition-all

placeholders.logo: Use a text-based logo with 'Nunito' font: 'Mazhar' in Teal, 'Wellness' in Gray.

motion_guidelines.page_load: Staggered fade-in for grid items (Framer Motion recommended)
motion_guidelines.micro_interactions: Buttons should scale down slightly (0.98) on click.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use generic 'hospital blue' (#007BFF). Stick to the Teal/Sage palette.
DO NOT use sharp corners. Everything must be rounded (min rounded-lg).
Ensure text contrast is high. Use Slate-800 for main text, not pure black.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Mobile responsiveness is critical - check touch targets (min 44px).
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-trust healthcare platform. Prioritize clarity and calmness. The dashboard should feel like a wellness journal, not a spreadsheet. Use the 'Nunito' font to inject warmth into the UI. Follow the 'Soft Utility' aesthetic for the dashboard: white cards on a soft gray background, no harsh borders.
